problem: UICOMP-1 added an optional DOM `id` to Badge (BadgeProps.id), but the Badge Storybook page did not document or demonstrate it. Consumers reading Storybook could not discover that a badge can be referenced by other elements (for example via aria-describedby), or that the id is optional.
solution: Stories-only change in stories/components/feedback/Badge.stories.ts. Added an `id` entry to argTypes (text control) describing it as an optional DOM id for associating the badge with other elements, noting that empty renders no id attribute and that it does not change label or tone. Extended the component docs description with a short usage note matching UICOMP-1's API (updateBadge removes a previous id when id is omitted or empty). Added a WithDomId story rendering createBadge({ label: 'Coming Soon', tone: 'muted', id: 'chapter-3-status' }) next to a button whose aria-describedby references it, plus a code label showing the rendered id. Default args are unchanged, so the id is not set unless chosen. Playground, Tones, StatusExamples and LightDarkComparison are unchanged. No Badge implementation, CSS, token, test or workflow changes.
tests: npm run check: exit 0 — lint, format:check, typecheck, vitest (55 files, 689 tests passed), build, publint + consumer smoke test passed, build-storybook (Storybook build OK: 401 entries, 21 groups, 2 themes)

Chromium/Playwright against the built storybook-static: all six Badge entries present (docs, playground, tones, status-examples, light-dark-comparison, with-dom-id); each story renders its badges with no page errors; with-dom-id renders span#chapter-3-status 'Coming Soon' and the button's aria-describedby equals 'chapter-3-status'
risks: None identified for consumers: stories-only change, no exported API, CSS or token changes. Limitation: the fixed example id 'chapter-3-status' would duplicate if the story were rendered twice on one docs page; it renders once. No screen-reader listening test was performed.
review: Confirm the argTypes `id` description matches UICOMP-1's BadgeProps.id (optional string; omitted or empty removes the attribute) and does not imply it is required. Confirm Playground, Tones, StatusExamples and LightDarkComparison stories are present and unchanged. Confirm WithDomId shows the id on the rendered badge and that the diff touches only Badge.stories.ts and .agent/pr-description.json.
